# Open Knowledge Studio — LLM Documentation Index
> AI-consumable documentation index for the Open Knowledge Studio project.
> Total: 16 sections, 105+ files. Last updated: 2026-07-28.

## Project Identity
- **Name:** Open Knowledge Studio (OKS) v2.0
- **Tagline:** Zero-dependency · Browser-native · 12-Agent A2A Platform
- **Description:** A private AI research laboratory in your browser — 12 specialized agents collaborate on research, writing, and data analysis. All data stays local, zero backend required.
- **License:** MIT
- **Repository:** https://github.com/zsdotcom/zs-oks
- **Foundation:** ZarishSphere Foundation (https://zarishsphere.com)
- **Author:** Mohammad Ariful Islam (codeandbrain)
- **Tech Stack:** React 19.2, TypeScript 7.0, Vite 8.1, Tailwind CSS 4.x, IndexedDB, Transformers.js (CDN Worker), Orama JS (CDN), KaTeX (CDN), Mermaid (CDN), Leaflet.js (CDN)
